relationships.evidence_quote: Measuring tonic block at the first pulse in compound, an IC50 of 4.7 ± 0.8 nM (n = 3) was calculated.

relationships.subject: MSD199
relationships.evidence_quote: This represented a significant decrease in the magnitude of ADS in all 13 MSD199-treated c-nociceptors compared to vehicle controls

relationships.subject: MSD199
relationships.evidence_quote: IV MSD199 dose-dependently prevented capsaicin flare propagation relative to vehicle

key_findings: Selective Nav1.8 inhibitor MSD199 reduced activity-dependent slowing in rhesus c-nociceptors and capsaicin flare, and had analgesic-like effect only in capsaicin-sensitized thermal assay.
MSD199 had no effect in non-sensitized thermal assay whereas a Nav1.7 inhibitor did.
